activities.title: Effect Execution Explorer
activities.instruction: Change the dependency configuration and identify when the effect executes.

content.concept: Understand that useEffect runs after rendering according to its dependency configuration.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Runs once after the initial render
Runs when a listed dependency changes
config.answer: Runs when a listed dependency changes

activities.title: Dependency Array Lab
activities.instruction: Choose the dependency list that matches the values used by the effect.

content.concept: Use dependency arrays to tell React which values an effect depends on.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Custom Hook Explorer
activities.instruction: Identify the reusable logic that belongs inside a custom hook.

content.concept: Recognize custom hooks as reusable functions that share stateful React logic between components.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: A custom hook that exposes reusable online-status logic.
A component consuming the custom hook.
Another component consuming the same reusable logic.
Logic that can be shared without duplicating it in each component.

activities.title: Hook Dependency Debugger
activities.instruction: Identify the missing dependency that causes an effect to use stale data.

content.concept: Debug useEffect dependency lists so effects respond to the values they actually use.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
